purpose: Battle candidate 1: melodic adventure rock; comparison only, not integrated
prompt: Melodic adventure rock battle theme, 140 BPM. Bright daring momentum, setting out with handmade high-tech equipment. Crisp rhythmic electric guitar, tuneful warm electric bass, tight punchy acoustic drum kit and clear optimistic synth responses. An original short rising four-bar guitar hook with a memorable answering phrase. Rhythmic sparse A section, opening into a catchy instrumental chorus around 20 to 30 seconds, returning around 60 to 75 seconds. Chorus lifts the melodic contour and harmony without filling every frequency or becoming an extended solo. Keep the sense of a human-scale adventurous workshop world. Instrumental soundtrack for a fast readable 2D action game about explorer-artisans using crafted firearms and advanced devices. Cool, adventurous and exciting, moderate stable dynamics. Catchiness comes from melody and rhythm, not louder mastering. Leave gaps for gameplay shots, hits and alerts; controlled bass, restrained cymbals, uncluttered midrange. Dry clear mix with short room ambience and clean transients. Steady 4/4, recurring phrases suited to loop editing. Begin immediately with the groove; no long introduction, fade-out or final cadence. No voices, singing, speech, lyrics, gunshots, clicks, alarms or environmental sound effects. No folk or tribal instrumentation, cavernous reverb, dark drones, horror, military marches, heavy metal walls, EDM drops or oversized boss-battle orchestra.
